extractedText: Home Entertainment K-POP JYP rookie group ”NEXZ” unveils concept visual for debut single Comment JYP rookie group ”NEXZ” unveils concept visual for debut single View Gallery (+8) JYP Entertainment's (JYP) rookie boy group NEXZ has revealed the jacket photo of its debut single for the first time. JYP officially announced the debut of NEXZ on the 1st of this month through the video 'NEXZ "Ride the Vibe" Trailer' posted on their official SNS channel. official debut through the video 'NEXZ "Ride the Vibe" Trailer' posted on their official SNS channel. Multiple teasing contents have been shown to raise the excitement for the debut. At 0:00am on the 5th, the first teaser photos of the seven members were released, highlighting their chic appeal. The members are trendy styled in leather and denim material, giving off a young and fashionable vibe. In particular, their high-spirited gazes have a strong aura that overwhelms the viewer's gaze. The sensual mood of the four-section cut even adds to the cool atmosphere and attracts attention. Debut single 'Ride the Vibe' contains the title track of the same name and 'Starlight', two songs in total. Debut single 'Ride the Vibe' expresses the emotional vibes that arise in the heart, such as the thrill of excitement, which can be felt for the first time, through the lyrics. NEXZ' is expected to deliver a different kind of energy. NEXZ' is a new boy group born in 2023 through Season 2 of the 'Nizi Project', an audition programme co-produced by JYP and Japan's Sony Music. The group's name 'NEXZ' is an abbreviation of 'Next Z(Generation)' and was named by JYP representative producer and 'Nizi Project' jury member J.Y.Park with the hope of opening up the future with the new generation. NEXZ' debut single 'Ride the Vibe' will be released on 20 May at 6pm on various music websites. 2024/05/05 16:06 KST Copyrights(C) Edaily wowkorea.jp 110 Topics J.Y.
